scheme.title: 💰 Festive Volume Scheme
scheme.body:
Buy 10 ctns Aloo Bhujia 400g → Get 2 ctns FREE + ₹500 ZoPs credited to your account.

Valid till 31 Oct 2026.

Tap below to place your order with scheme pricing applied.

aiTyping.body: Scheme query detected, ZoAi is composing a response...

aiResponse.title: ZoAi Scheme Explanation
aiResponse.body: Bhai, is scheme mein aapko har 10 cartoons Aloo Bhujia par 2 cartoons FREE mil rahe hain. Matlab aap 10 ka pay karenge aur 12 ka maal milega. Plus ₹500 ZoPoints jo next order mein discount ki tarah use kar sakte hain. Scheme 31 Oct 2026 tak valid hai. Kya aap order dena chahenge? 😊

loyaltyQuery.title: 🏆 ZoAi — Points & Loyalty
loyaltyQuery.body: Shyam bhai, aapke current loyalty points 8,500 hain. Aap inhe next order mein ₹8,500 ke discount mein badal sakte hain. Aapka loyalty tier 'Silver' hai — 3% extra discount on all orders. Kya aap points redeem karna chahenge? 😊
